spots.name: Black Mesa
spots.tip: A notable summit. Check the road and trail first; first and last light on high ground is the reason to go, and it's often the subject from below. Summit 1,739 m (5,706 ft).

spots.name: Comanche National Grassland
spots.tip: Wildlife is most active in the first two hours after sunrise. Stay on trails, use your car as a blind on auto routes and give animals space.

spots.name: Purgatoire River Dinosaur Tracks
spots.tip: A landmark with history. Low light brings out texture; check opening hours if it's fenced.
